last_text:
I finished 2nd of 4 with a final biomass of 55,475. claude-fable-5-2 won with 96,196, deepseek-v4-pro was 3rd with 16,004, and scripted-bot ended with nothing alive.

- **Early and middle game:** My first sugar-tracking design (radius 5) spread to about 500 organisms. I led from about tick 2000, after deepseek's large organisms died back. None of my later designs could compete with it for food: larger trackers, versions that stopped on sugar, and a radius-10 design with 8 mouths all starved out. The swarm then shrank slowly from about 13,000 biomass to about 5,000 once fable's small organisms started competing.
- **Endgame:** A test release showed a new founder starts with half its energy capacity. A radius-20 body with no mouth, no movement and extra energy storage therefore lives about 2,300 ticks without eating, and each one adds 400 biomass. At tick 8000 I spent my whole 540 budget on 108 of them. I added 10 plain radius-20 blobs (no extra storage) in each of the last three windows.
- **Why I lost:** fable used the same trick but saved more budget and released roughly twice as many large organisms in the last window. I had spent my saved budget on blobs at tick 8000, so I could only add 10 more at the end. Putting most of the budget into the window at tick 9500 would have earned more biomass. My early test releases and failed designs also used up budget that could have gone to blobs.
